---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for the community platform
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing. (Please state the problem independently of your proposed solution).

### Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and the proposed behavior.

### Affected Area
Which part of the platform does this touch?
- [ ] API (`apps/api`)
- [ ] Web client (`apps/web`)
- [ ] Database schema (needs a migration)
- [ ] Moderation (community moderators)
- [ ] Platform administration
- [ ] Other (please specify)

### Who is it for?
- [ ] Users
- [ ] Community moderators
- [ ] Platform administrators

### Privacy and Abuse
Does this expose data to anyone who could not see it before, or open a way to spam or harass other users? Describe how it should be limited (permissions, rate limits, blocks).

### Alternatives considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered (including doing nothing).

### Breaking Changes
Would this feature change existing API routes, responses, or behaviors?
- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
- [ ] Unsure

### Additional context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
